- AGENTFORCE OPERATIONS - announced 2026-04-29, GENERALLY AVAILABLE.
  https://www.salesforce.com/news/stories/agentforce-operations-announcement/  (403 direct; recovered via
  martech.org, constellationr.com, pulse2.com)
  Extends Agentforce agents from front-office experiences into BACK-OFFICE processes and systems - email, ERP and
  collaboration tools - for "end-to-end agentic execution across the back office." Positioned against legacy
  workflow tools on the basis that "agents are designed to complete work rather than route it."
  Specialized Agents that "extract data from complex documents, run computations, update credit models and identify
  compliance gaps"; agents handle data verification, approvals and compliance checks.
  30+ pre-configured BLUEPRINTS for processes such as invoice auditing, onboarding and purchase-order rescheduling;
  blueprints can also be generated from unstructured process documents.
  Surfaces work into Slack and Microsoft Teams. Processes are changed with plain-language updates.
  Governance surface claimed: audit trails; agents proactively flag bottlenecks.
  Ecosystem integration - auto-sync data and trigger actions with Salesforce Flows - was slated for beta May 2026.
  Claimed effect: 50-70% cycle-time reduction, 80% less manual data entry.
